steps.title: Evaporation
steps.description: The Sun heats water, turning it into vapor that rises.

steps.title: Condensation
steps.description: Vapor cools into droplets that form clouds.

steps.title: Precipitation
steps.description: Droplets fall as rain, snow, sleet or hail.

steps.title: Collection
steps.description: Water gathers in rivers, lakes, oceans and underground.
